summary: Completed focused final verification for landing/admin flows on public preview, corrected iteration4 delete-policy interpretation, fixed backend test hygiene omissions, and validated CMS/API persistence with strict restore.

integration_issues.issue: Canvas visible-vs-hidden compositor pixel delta passed, but my centroid heuristic on clipped screenshots did not show strong positional shift at sampled scroll points; this is a verification-method limitation, not an API/UI failure.

action_items: Correct record: iteration4 backend 'delete only QA leads' finding was invalid/misinterpreted. Authorized admin deletion of selected lead works and was validated on synthetic records with confirmation.
Optional (non-blocking): if strict automated motion-centroid proof is required, add deterministic telemetry/test mode for Scene3D transform state sampling.
critical_code_review_comments: Test hygiene fixes applied: iteration4 regression suite now cleans created QA leads/media and restores page-content after stale-revision test.
Auth fixtures now fail loudly (assert) if real admin login breaks, instead of skip.
Legacy API test payloads updated for current mandatory country/country_code requirement using IN/+91 and frontend env BASE_URL fallback.
seed_data_creation: Created synthetic QA leads (inline/popup) and deleted them; uploaded QA media during validation and marked QA media filenames as is_deleted in cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final state confirmed restored: hero tagline 'One mala. A complete spiritual companion.' and hero image '/assets/rudralife/gold-mala-premium.png'. Public routes '/' and '/siddha-mala.html' load. No option-nesting warnings observed for inline/popup country selects and lead status/filter selects. 503 interception test confirmed no false success and field retention. Admin search/status/notes/export/delete/logout validated on synthetic records.
rca of the issue: Iteration4 critical issue root cause was requirement misinterpretation, not backend defect: 'delete ONLY QA leads' was test-data cleanup guidance. Backend delete endpoint correctly allows authorized admin to delete selected leads after confirmation.
